svg.title: Usage statistics for the instance — SoftTrack web design mockup (#312)
svg.desc: Whether anybody uses the instance, how fast its attachments are growing and whether its emails are arriving are questions a site admin answers with SQL. A page for site admins gives people, work, storage, email, webhooks and API tokens as counts, names teams and shows nothing of the content, and sends nothing anywhere.
svg.text: Questions a site admin answered with SQL

svg.text: The Prometheus endpoint, #100, is for machines that watch an
instance. This is the page for the person who looks after one.
Done when Administration → Usage shows accounts by state and how many signed in during the last 7 and 30 days, tickets created and closed per week, attachment bytes in total
and per team with the largest files, email sent and failed with the last error, failed webhook deliveries by team, and API tokens live and never used; as counts, with no ticket titles;
computed when the page is opened; and sent nowhere.
